note: Owner-editable (2026-09-25): which character features combat automates with which building block, and their numbers. Keys are typed-mechanic ids (APP/authority/Tianxia_Typed_Mechanics_Authority_R1.json). Resources: qi, stamina, resonance, martial_focus. Numbers may be an integer or 'pb' (proficiency bonus) or 'key_mod', or 'typed' for a hit_ac 'ac' and a hit_ac/save_rescue/damage_reduction 'cost' (owner 2026-09-30: read from the feature's typed record, so an owner edit of the printed number, authority/typed_mechanics/owner_text_edits.json, reaches the table without a second copy here; combat/typed_numbers.py). Blocks: natural_weapon (an attack the character always has), technique_potency (adds a bonus to one damage roll of each activation paid with the resource or granted by the Path), extra_attack (attacks per Attack action by CL; applies to weapon and natural attacks), on_hit_damage (extra damage on each hit with the listed attack_kinds, weapon and/or unarmed; once_per_turn limits it to one hit per turn), resistance (half damage of the listed types; mundane_only counts only weapons with no refinement grade and no enchantment), defense (always-on damage defences, 2026-09-26: a list of {kind, damage_types} where kind is resistance, immunity, vulnerability, reduction (minus amount), or ignore_resistance (the character's own attacks of attack_kinds ignore that Resistance; melee_only); options: mundane_only, attacks_only, immune_below_source_cl (immune to damage from a lower CL), requires: unarmored / no_heavy_armor (checked against worn armour) or martial_focus (held when the damage lands); order: immunity, resistance, vulnerability, reduction; the feature's other parts still compile), damage_soak (reaction: before damage lands, spend up to max_spend resource and reduce the damage by 1d<die> each), damage_reduction (reaction: when hit by a melee weapon or unarmed attack, reduce the damage by dice + bonus; free unless cost is set; tried before damage_soak), hit_ac (reaction: when hit, pay cost and gain +ac AC until the start of your next turn, including against that hit), save_rescue (after failing a save of a listed ability, pay cost and add pb; reaction true uses the reaction, false is once per round), already_applied (nothing to add: the effect is already in the sheet or the compiled actions). choose_one: the printed feature says Choose one and the sheet does not record the pick, so the table asks which listed ability the fighter chose (combat/ext/defensive_disciplines.py, the save_rescue_abilities hook) and uses that one for the rest of the fight; until they answer, and in any fight with nobody to ask, the Factory falls back to the weakest listed save. Reactions fire only when affordable and big enough to matter (minimum_damage). Edits apply to the next fight. motion (owner 2026-09-28): movement passives, 'rules' a list of {kind: speed_bonus | ignore_difficult | oa_disadvantage | no_oa_unseen | regain_focus | hide_advantage | afterimage | disengage_hex, while: martial_focus | obscured, ...} read by combat/motion.py.

tianxia.path.qi_cultivation.feature.qi_a.why: The AC bonus and the cost are the typed record's (the owner's edit, owner_text_edits.json: +5 AC from 2026-09-30); the CL10 price is printed only as a sentence, so it stays here and tests/test_owner_text_edits.py checks it against the printed text.

tianxia.path.qi_cultivation.feature.nasc.why: Independent Concentration (fight audit 2026-09-29: typed as a reaction to any failed CON save that rolled a stray save and handed out Nascent Continuity's Qi). Nascent Continuity (0 Qi at turn start: regain PB, once per scene) is combat/ext/qi_path.py's turn-start hook, keyed on this reaction row.

covers: This increases to three attacks at CL11 and four attacks at CL17.
tianxia.path.body_refining.feature.extra.why: AUTO1 2026-10-04: attacks_by_cl already resolves the printed CL11 and CL17 increase (combat/typed_reactions.py compile_blocks -> attacks_for_cl, read by combat/ext/special_attacks.py), so the printed line is the table's own rule and is no longer left as a GM line. The second rider, about an attack granted outside the Attack action not triggering another extra attack, stays with the GM until combat/ext/second_attack.py can be shown to enforce it for every source.

tianxia.path.body_refining.feature.unarm.why: The sheet's Armor Class already uses 10 + CON + PB.

tianxia.path.body_refining.feature.refin.why: Iron Fist attacks already count as cultivation-powered (never mundane).

TAL_LIGHTNING_CONDUCTIVE_STRIKE.why: Weapons are assumed metallic (Conductive); unarmed strikes need a Charge, so they are left to the GM. The Conductive condition and the CL5 Charge upgrade are applied by combat/ext/charge_marks.py's after_hit hook.

TAL_IRON_FIST_BODY_CONDITIONING.why: +1 AC while holding Martial Focus without a Shield (owner 2026-09-28); when you take Bludgeoning damage, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.

TAL_IRON_FIST_BELL_TOWER_BODY.why: While holding Martial Focus and not wearing Heavy armor: reduce B/P/S damage from nonmagical attacks by PB. The retaliation is not automated.

tianxia.subpath.body.adamant_thunderbolt.why: Resistance to Force and Thunder; unarmed strikes ignore ordinary Resistance to Bludgeoning, Lightning, Thunder and Force.

tianxia.subpath.body.black_thorn_demon_b.why: Resistance to Piercing and Slashing. Demon Spine ignoring P/S Resistance is not automated.

tianxia.subpath.body.jigoku.feature.hell.why: Immunity to Fire damage, Resistance to Necrotic damage.

tianxia.subpath.body.yamabushi.feature.s.why: While benefiting from Unarmored Defense (no body armour): +1 AC; Resistance to Cold.

tianxia.subpath.qi.venomous_poison_culti.why: Immunity to Poison damage from a lower Source CL, Resistance otherwise.

tianxia.talent.poison.thousand_poison_im.why: Immunity to ordinary (mundane) poison; Resistance to Poison and Acid damage.

tianxia.subpath.body.heaven_thunder_drum.why: Resistance to Thunder and Force damage.

tianxia.subpath.body.ryujin.feature.drag.why: While benefiting from Unarmored Defense (no body armour): +1 AC; Resistance to Lightning.

tianxia.subpath.body.thousand_fold_steel.why: Body Refining melee attacks ignore ordinary Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing.

tianxia.subpath.qi.heaven_thunder_storm_.why: Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage.

TAL_ATHLETICS_SWIFT_MOVEMENT.why: While holding Martial Focus, increase all movement Speeds by 10 feet.

TAL_ATHLETICS_UNIMPEDED_POSITIONING.why: While holding Martial Focus, ignore nonmagical difficult terrain.

TAL_ATHLETICS_MOBILITY.why: Opportunity attacks made against you for leaving a creature's reach have Disadvantage.

ATHLETICS_BASE_COORDINATED_MOVEMENT.why: Dash or Disengage as your Action regains Martial Focus (not as a Bonus Action).

TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_GATHER_THE_CURRENT.why: Dodge or Disengage as your Action regains Martial Focus (not as a Bonus Action).

TAL_ATHLETICS_AFTERIMAGE.why: Move more than 20 feet in a turn: an afterimage until the start of your next turn; an attacker that can see it rolls a d2 and on a 1 strikes the afterimage, which is destroyed.

foundation.ancient_desolate_sacred_body_.why: Gain Golden Sea Pulse (max 1, once a round) after hostile damage, a close hit on a creature that pressed you since your last turn, or a Saint-Body Frame resistance roll; it expires at the end of your next turn. Not automated: winning a hostile physical contest.
Once a round, +PB to a Strength or Constitution save against forced movement, Prone, Grappled, Restrained or another hold on the body. The +2 x PB hit points are in the build.

TAL_IRON_FIST_IRON_FIST_TRAINING.why: Iron Fist's Opening and Open the Gate: an Unarmed Strike that deals damage, or a failed save against its Grapple or Shove option, Opens the target until the end of your next turn; once a turn, Open the Gate (Centerline Impact, Hooking Step or Breath-Checking Strike).

TAL_DARK_STEP_THROUGH_DARKNESS.why: A Meld on yourself: while in darkness, a Bonus Action teleport of up to half your Speed to a visible open square also in darkness; 1 CP for your full Speed. The table does not track dim light, so it counts areas of darkness, smoke, fog or obscurement.

TAL_IRON_FIST_IRON_SHIRT_PRACTICE.why: While holding Martial Focus and not in Heavy armor, damage of the chosen type from a nonmagical weapon, natural weapon or Unarmed Strike is reduced by PB. The type chosen after a long rest is Bludgeoning here (change damage_types to Piercing or Slashing).

tianxia.subpath.body.iron_shirt.feature..why: +1 AC with Unarmored Defense; Advantage on Constitution saves against Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified and Stunned.

tianxia.talent.equipment.mountain_patter.why: +1 AC while wearing medium or heavy Fitted Armor (the worn armour counts as Fitted). Not automated: losing it while Incapacitated or with another persistent AC talent.

tianxia.talent.equipment.padded_layers.why: Once per round, while wearing armor, Bludgeoning damage reduced by PB. Falling damage takes the same round's one reduction at twice the Proficiency Bonus instead (combat/ext/equipment_armor.py, the falling and falling_damage seams); collision with an object or surface is not damage the table deals.

TAL_FENCING_FEINT.why: Feint is the table's Feint action (Help yourself against a creature within 5 feet: Advantage on your next attack against it), not a bonus on every attack.

TAL_UNMAKING_EXECUTION_THROUGH_THE_FAULT.why: With Overdraw ready: against a Bloodied creature an Unmaking talent damages, spend 2 CP for 10d8 Ruin damage instead of the Overdraw bonus, then Ruin Backlash; a kill removes 2 Black Vein Strain. Not automated: no healing until the end of your next turn when it does not kill.

TAL_UNMAKING_CRACK_THE_NAME_OF_THE_TOOL.why: When an Unmaking talent damages a summoned or bound creature: a Wisdom save or Disadvantage on its attack rolls until the end of its next turn; then 1 Black Vein Strain.

tianxia.subpath.body.shinobi.feature.sil.why: While in darkness, smoke, fog or an obscured area: ignore nonmagical difficult terrain and Hide with Advantage; no opportunity attack from a creature that can't see you. The Stealth proficiency is in the sheet; the Climb Speed is not automated (GM); the table does not track dim light.
